workflow_runs.display_title: bound slow-client writes with WriteTimeout, keep SSE alive

head_commit.message:
bound slow-client writes with WriteTimeout, keep SSE alive

WriteTimeout was 0, so a slow/stalled client could pin a connection
indefinitely. Set a 5-minute server-wide write deadline as the backstop;
the SSE run-events stream renews its own write deadline via
ResponseController on every replay flush and heartbeat (12s interval,
deadline 2x), so long-lived event streams are unaffected while every
other route gets the bounded timeout.

workflow_runs.name: aiops-workflow-gates
workflow_runs.display_title: replace fixed-window rate limiter with token bucket

head_commit.message:
replace fixed-window rate limiter with token bucket

The fixed 1s window allowed a 2x burst at the boundary: 2x limit could
pass when requests straddled a window reset, twice the intended load to
ClickHouse. Switch to a token bucket (capacity = limit, refill limit/s)
which caps instantaneous burst at the bucket size while keeping the same
long-run average. Regression tests cover burst capping, proportional
refill, and the limit<=0 unlimited case.

workflow_runs.name: aiops-workflow-gates
workflow_runs.display_title: remove dead multiline execution loop and misleading relaxation comments

head_commit.message:
remove dead multiline execution loop and misleading relaxation comments

check_shell_metachars has blocked newlines/redirection since the P0 fix,
so script reaching execute_suggestion is always a single line: the
splitlines() loop only ever ran its first iteration. Replace it with a
direct single execution, keep the audit outcome semantics (timeout now
audited as error instead of slipping past the log), and rewrite the
stale "relaxed per product request" comments in both execution sites to
accurately state the current policy coupling — anyone loosening the
metachar filter must re-review these shell=True paths.

workflow_runs.name: aiops-workflow-gates
workflow_runs.display_title: cover all authorization fields in approval signature and contract hash

head_commit.message:
cover all authorization fields in approval signature and contract hash

The Ed25519 approval signature whitelisted only 4 contract fields, so
tampering with allowed_tools (wider tool surface), max_scope
(namespace->cluster escalation) or rollback_policy (disabling auto
rollback) left the payload unchanged and passed verification. Same gap
in contract_hash's integrity check.

- _payload now signs the full contract_fields dict (sorted-key canonical
  JSON), so fields added to the contract later are covered automatically
- execution_adapter._verify_signature passes the complete authorization
  field set; contract_hash covers tools/max_scope/rollback_policy too
- regression tests: parametrized tampering of each authz field must fail
  verification, hash must detect each tampered field, end-to-end
  privilege-escalation scenarios locked in test_s7_signature_full_coverage

workflow_runs.name: aiops-workflow-gates
workflow_runs.display_title: close P2 findings S6/S10/A3/F3/F4 from audit

head_commit.message:
close P2 findings S6/S10/A3/F3/F4 from audit

- S6: constant-time token comparison in credential-broker, action-executor
  (3 sites) and ingest API key check via subtle.ConstantTimeCompare
- S10: tighten event-collector WAL files/dirs to 0600/0750 (incl. compaction
  reopen and ack tmp file)
- A3: phase4-gate.sh gates A/B/C now ride on the real coverage test's exit
  code plus SKIP detection (skip == not proven), set -euo pipefail, mktemp
  logs instead of fixed /tmp paths
- F3: move 8 historical reports/plans out of the repo root into
  docs/archive/ with a README marking them non-contractual
- F4: Makefile resolves AIOPS_PYTHON (explicit override > .venv314 >
  python3) via absolute path instead of hardcoding .venv314

workflow_runs.name: aiops-workflow-gates
workflow_runs.display_title: close P1 audit findings across proxy, approval store, CI and deploy

head_commit.message:
close P1 audit findings across proxy, approval store, CI and deploy

- egress proxy: reject all traffic when PROXY_TOKEN is unset instead of
  forwarding with injected provider keys (fail-open -> fail-closed)
- approval store: log MySQL write failures and expose degraded() instead
  of silently dropping durable approval decisions; whitelist UPDATE
  columns to block dynamic-column SQL injection from future callers
- CI: run gates on push to main (direct commits previously bypassed all
  gates), add least-privilege permissions and concurrency group
- deps: pin the CI Python closure via requirements-lock.txt so builds
  are reproducible; torch-class lazy runtime deps stay unpinned by design
- apply.sh: refuse weak ADMIN_PASSWORD / dev- JWT / disabled first-login
  password change when AIOPS_ENV=production; keep bash 3.2 compatibility
  (no mapfile, empty-array-safe expansion under set -u)
